about.title: About LifeApp
about.summary: What the app is for and how your data is kept.

what.title: What is LifeApp?
what.body: LifeApp is a personal notebook for everyday life. It keeps your spending, your goals and your weekly plan in one place, so you can see how your time, your money and your plans fit together.

items.dashboard: Dashboard — a one-page overview of your month.
items.expenses: Expenses — record what you spend in USD, KHR or MYR.
items.planning: Planning — set goals and break them into small steps.
items.schedule: Schedule — plan your week, one activity at a time.

languages.title: Your language
languages.body: LifeApp works in English, Khmer and Malay. Change the language at any time from the language menu — your data stays the same. Things you type yourself, like category names, goals and notes, are shown exactly as you wrote them.

data.title: Your data
data.body: Your data is saved in your account, so you see the same information on every phone or computer you log in to. Add an email to your profile so you can reset your password if you forget it.

gettingStarted.title: How to use the app
gettingStarted.summary: Create an account, find your way around and make the app yours.

steps.s2: Enter your full name, a username and a password. Email is optional, but you need it to reset a forgotten password.
steps.s3: Choose Create account. You're ready to go.

items.phone: On a phone, use the bar at the bottom of the screen to switch modules. The menu button at the top opens settings, language and theme.
items.desktop: On a tablet or computer, use the sidebar on the left. You can fold it to show icons only.
items.search: Search: press Ctrl + K (⌘ + K on a Mac) to jump to any page.

quickAdd.title: Add an expense in seconds
quickAdd.body: On a phone, tap the round + button at the bottom right of most pages to add an expense. On a computer, use Add expense on the dashboard or the expenses page.

items.language: Language — English, Khmer or Malay, from the language menu.
items.theme: Theme — light, dark or the same as your device.
items.profile: Profile — change your name, username, email and photo in Settings.
items.password: Password — change it in Settings, or choose Forgot password? on the login page to reset it with a code sent to your email.

install.title: Add to your home screen
install.summary: Install LifeApp on your phone so it opens like a normal app.

why.title: Why install it?
why.body: Once installed, LifeApp opens from its own icon, full screen, without the browser bar. It is the same app with the same data — there is nothing to download from an app store.

steps.s2: Tap the Share button (a square with an arrow pointing up).
steps.s3: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen.
steps.s4: Tap Add. The LifeApp icon appears on your home screen.

steps.s2: Tap the ⋮ menu at the top right.
steps.s3: Tap Install app or Add to Home screen.
steps.s4: Tap Install to confirm. The LifeApp icon appears with your other apps.

steps.s1: Open LifeApp in Chrome or Microsoft Edge.
steps.s2: Click the install icon at the right end of the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose Install LifeApp.
steps.s3: LifeApp opens in its own window. You can pin it to the taskbar or Dock.

offline.title: Without internet
offline.body: LifeApp needs an internet connection to load and save your data. If you open it while offline, you'll see a short message — try again when you're back online.

overview.title: What it is
overview.body: The dashboard is the first page you see after you log in. It brings the most important numbers from every module together for the month.

items.spent: Spending totals for each currency, compared with last month.
items.daily: Daily spending — a chart of how much you spent each day.
items.category: By category — where your money went. Tap a category to see its expenses.
items.today: Today's schedule — what is happening now and what's next.
items.goals: Goals — the progress of your active goals.

month.title: Look back at another month
month.body: Use the month picker at the top to go to an earlier month. The spending numbers and charts update together.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.summary: Record what you spend and see where your money goes.

steps.s1: Tap + on a phone, or choose Add expense.
steps.s2: Type the amount and choose the currency: USD, KHR or MYR.
steps.s3: Pick a category and the date. Add a note if you like.

items.month: Use the month picker to move between months.
items.filter: Filter by category or currency, search your notes, and sort by date or amount.
items.totals: The totals at the top add up the whole month, one total per currency.

edit.title: Edit or delete
edit.body: Open the ⋯ menu on an expense to edit or delete it. Deleted one by mistake? Choose Undo in the message that appears.

currencies.title: About currencies
currencies.body: Each expense is saved in the currency you chose. Totals for USD, KHR and MYR are always kept apart — the app never mixes or converts currencies.

categories.title: Categories
categories.body: Categories group your expenses so you can see where your money goes. The app starts with common ones such as Food, Transport and Rent. Open the Categories tab to add your own with an icon and a color. Default categories can't be changed or deleted.

planning.title: Planning
planning.summary: Set goals and reach them step by step.

steps.s2: Give it a title. You can also add a description, an area (such as Health or Career), a priority and a target date.
steps.s3: Save it, then open the goal to add steps.

steps.title: Break it into steps
steps.body: Inside a goal, add small steps one by one. Tick a step when it's done and the goal's progress updates by itself. Steps can have a due date, and you can drag them to change their order. When every step is done, the app asks if you want to mark the goal as done.

items.filters: Filter by area, search, and sort by due date, progress or title.
items.stats: The cards at the top show your active goals, goals done this year, overdue goals and average progress.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.summary: Plan your week, one activity at a time.

items.week: Week — a time grid for the whole week (tablet and computer).
items.agenda: Agenda — a simple list of what's coming up.

steps.s1: Click an empty time slot, or choose New activity (the + button on a phone).
steps.s2: Enter a title, a type (Meeting, Work, Exercise…), the date and the start and end time. A location and a note are optional.
steps.s3: To repeat it, choose every day, every weekday or certain days of the week, with an optional end date.

move.title: Move and change activities
move.body: Drag an activity to another time or day. If it repeats, the app asks whether to change only this one or the whole series. With a keyboard, focus an activity, press Space, use the arrow keys, then press Space again.

items.arrows: ← / → — previous or next week or day
